fusion: #6 MoE Up/Gate grouped GEMM + SwiGLU epilogue
tuning_protocol: Per regime, per side: coarse grid (SMEM- and accumulator-prefiltered, identical generation rules for both sides) then a neighbourhood refine around the coarse winner. The unfused chain's two kernels are tuned SEPARATELY (GEMM alone, silu_and_mul alone), then the top-3 x top-3 combinations are re-timed AS A CHAIN and the best chain is reported, so the separately-tuned optimum cannot under-sell the unfused side. Each regime runs in its own process for crash isolation.

verification.note: Interleaved A/B/A/B re-measurement of the tuned winners (4 rounds, fused and unfused alternating) plus an SMEM-feasibility probe. Added because the main run reported a GEMM-alone time at prefill_t8192 (52.2 ms) larger than the same GEMM inside the unfused chain (38.7 ms) -- an impossible ordering that turned out to be a one-off outlier in that sequential block. The interleaved rounds reproduce every speedup to within 1-2%.
